messages:
alyssa_pm: Quick sync — need a final call on the response-adapter contract (structured outputs + tool calling) before roadmap freeze Monday. High level options below, want a clear cut we can ship in next sprint.

alyssa_pm: Options: A) Minimal validation + best-effort fallback (fast, lower QA). B) Strong schema validation + explicit error codes + contract tests (slower, higher QA). C) Hybrid: strict for opt-in routes, permissive by default.

dmitri_eng: +1 on getting an explicit decision. engineering constraints: strong validation (B) adds ~2 sprint infra + ~1 sprint for rollout testing. Hybrid (C) could be incremental.

dmitri_eng: Edge cases to call out: nested tool responses, streaming partial tool outputs, and when KV cache prefixes include truncated JSON. Need clear behavior for truncated/partial messages.

suki_ml: For quality/regression we need at least schema-level unit tests (examples + negative cases). Prefer B for any route that will call external tools or update customer data.

marco_proddesign: From UX/PM perspective customers expect deterministic shapes for ingestion. If we go hybrid, we should make default routes explicit in the Console as "strict" or "lenient" to avoid surprises.

alyssa_pm: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- All strict routes return either 200 + valid JSON matching schema OR 4xx with documented error payload.
- Error payload must include `code`, `message`, `path` (where validation failed), and `example_fix` when possible.
- Contract tests (positive + negative) added to repo for each strict route.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contracts/pull/324 – includes schema DSL, validator shim, and example contract tests.

nora_se: Security note: must ensure no sensitive fields are stripped silently. If validation removes a field, we must log an audit event and surface a non-opaque error to the caller.

dmitri_eng: Implementation sketch (high level):
```
- schema DSL -> compiled validator (runtime)
- validator returns (ok | err{code, path, message})
- if err and route.strict -> reject and emit audit log
- if err and route.lenient -> emit warning header + best-effort correction if heuristics available
```

marco_proddesign: Suggested error codes: VALIDATION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, TOOL_INVOCATION_FAILED, PARTIAL_STREAM, SANITIZATION_REMOVED. Keep codes stable and documented in Console.

alyssa_pm: Rollout plan suggestion:
1) Merge schema DSL + runtime behind feature flag.
2) Add contract tests for 3 pilot routes (chat-functions, rerank, embedding-postprocess).
3) Enable strict mode for pilot routes only; monitor errors for 2 weeks.
4) Decide broad rollout based on error uplift and customer feedback.

suki_ml: Observability hooks we need: per-request validation duration, validation failure histograms by route, sample payloads (redacted), and tag by customer/org.

dmitri_eng: Tradeoffs to call out in PRD: latency impact (validation adds ~2-5ms per request for small schemas, more for nested), developer ergonomics for schema authoring, and migration story for existing customers.

alyssa_pm: Launch criteria (final draft):
- Pilot routes pass contract tests and <0.05% expected false positives on validation for one week.
- No high-severity regressions in model outputs tied to validation.
- Console shows validation metrics + error docs.
- Customer opt-in available + documentation + migration guide published.

marco_proddesign: Small note — add a sample section in docs: "How to migrate: common fixes" with examples of `path` + `example_fix`. Makes support easier.

nora_se: Also document KMS/HSM handling for any fields we redact in contract tests; tests should not include plaintext secrets.

alyssa_pm: Decision request: Can eng commit to hybrid rollout (C) with immediate pilot on strict for 3 routes? If yes we'll lock PRD and schedule design + docs.

dmitri_eng: Yes, agree to hybrid. We'll scope infra work for sprint 1 (runtime + flags) and sprint 2 for pilot tests + rollout.

suki_ml: Agree. I'll own the contract tests and a basic negative-case corpus.

marco_proddesign: Agreed. I'll draft migration docs and Console UI copy.

alyssa_pm: Great — I'll update the PRD and mark this thread resolved. Putting action items in Asana after this. Thanks all :tada:
